note: Seeded from plan-tool field conventions. image_path/video_url are enrichment slots; app functional without media.

exercises.purpose: Glute max activation and endurance; the primary anti-fatigue movement for standing surgery.
exercises.cues: Ribs down, squeeze at top 2s, push through heels.
exercises.mistakes: Lumbar hyperextension substituting for glute drive.

exercises.purpose: Glute medius endurance; lateral pelvic stability during weight-shifting at the table.
exercises.cues: Pelvis stacked, no roll-back; open from hip.
exercises.mistakes: Rolling pelvis backward to fake range.

exercises.purpose: Isolated glute max firing without lumbar load.
exercises.cues: Move from hip, trunk still; small clean arc.
exercises.mistakes: Arching the low back to gain height.

exercises.purpose: Glute med under load in standing — directly transfers to OT stance.
exercises.cues: Athletic half-squat, tension on band throughout.
exercises.mistakes: Standing tall and letting band go slack.

exercises.purpose: Lateral core endurance — the McGill marker you also test weekly.
Extensor endurance with zero compressive spike; safe on any day.
exercises.cues: Imagine a glass of water on the low back.
Low back gently pressed to floor throughout.
exercises.mistakes: Ribs flaring as the leg lowers.

exercises.purpose: Gentle lumbar reset on red days; carried over from plan-tool.
exercises.cues: Flatten low back into floor, no breath-holding.

exercises.purpose: Functional quad/glute strength; the base pattern of all standing work.
exercises.cues: Hinge first, stand tall, control the descent.

exercises.purpose: Unilateral strength and balance; stair/travel confidence.
exercises.cues: Drive through the top-leg heel; no push-off from the floor leg.

exercises.purpose: Venous pump and ankle endurance — long standing and long flights both.
Direct static-standing tolerance training for the operating posture.
exercises.cues: Back flat on wall, thighs toward parallel, breathe evenly.

exercises.purpose: Loaded core + grip + posture endurance in one movement.
exercises.cues: Tall, level shoulders, don't lean away from the load.

exercises.purpose: Grooves the table-lean pattern so the spine stops paying for it.
exercises.cues: Push hips back, shins vertical, neutral spine.
Nose-breathing pace; you should be able to speak sentences.
exercises.mistakes: Turning it into a workout — this is the engine, not the test.

exercises.purpose: Zero-impact aerobic alternative; interchangeable with E15.
Zero-impact circulation on red / post-OT days when walking feels heavy.
exercises.cues: Effort so light it feels pointless — that is the point.

exercises.purpose: Upper-back endurance against the forward operating posture.
exercises.cues: Squeeze shoulder blades, elbows close, slow return.

checklist: Heat to lumbar — 10 min (can run in parallel)
5-min mobility: pelvic tilt, knee-to-chest, gentle hinge
